entities.name: Paging
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to notify UEs in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state about incoming calls, system information changes, or other events.

entities.name: Paging message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to page UEs, containing paging records and potentially system information modification indicators.

entities.name: Paging record
entities.description: Information element within paging message identifying a specific UE being paged using UE identity.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE monitors paging messages but has no active connection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE monitors paging messages while maintaining some connection context.

relations.description: Paging procedure involves sending paging messages to UEs.
Paging message contains one or more paging records to identify UEs being paged.
Paging procedure targets UEs in RRC_IDLE state.
Paging procedure also targets UEs in RRC_INACTIVE state.
